pricing.roiTitle: Why pay for an automatic stream promotion system?
pricing.roiText: If you stream 4 times a week and even 5 viewers miss each stream because they did not see the announcement, you lose 20 viewers every week. Streamer Scheduler makes sure your audience always knows when you go live.
pricing.faqQ1: Do I need this if I am a small streamer?
pricing.faqA1: Yes. Small streamers benefit the most from consistent schedules and automatic reminders because every viewer counts. A clear schedule and automatic promotion help you look more professional from day one.
pricing.faqQ2: Does it post automatically to Discord?
pricing.faqA2: Yes. You can configure automatic announcements to your Discord server, so your community always sees when you are about to go live.
pricing.faqQ3: Do I need OBS to use this?
pricing.faqA3: No. Overlays are optional. The core value is your schedule, public page and automatic announcements. If you use OBS or Streamlabs, you can also add overlays like “Next stream” or goals.
pricing.note: Prices may vary. Check Settings → Billing for current plans. Trial available for new users.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to common questions. For the full guide, see the documentation.
faq.a1: You can create an account with email and password or sign in with Google, Twitch, or Discord from the login screen.
faq.q2: How do I schedule a post?
faq.a2: Go to Schedule (menu) or Dashboard, fill in title, text, choose platforms (Twitch, Discord, X, etc.), set date and time, and save. Make sure those platforms are connected under Settings → Platforms.
faq.q3: Why didn't my content get published?
faq.a3: Check that the platform is connected in Settings → Platforms. If the token expired, disconnect and reconnect. Check the calendar or content detail for any publication error.
faq.q4: How do I connect Discord / Twitch / X / YouTube?
faq.a4: Go to Settings → Platforms and click Connect on the network you want. Sign in on the platform's page and accept permissions. For Discord, invite the bot to your server using the link shown in the app.
faq.q5: Where do Twitch clips get posted on Discord?
faq.a5: Under Settings → Platforms, in the "Twitch clips channel" section, choose the Discord server and channel where you want clips to be published and save.
faq.q6: Where do I see my license and when it expires?
faq.a6: On your Profile and under Settings → Billing. You can purchase or renew there if payments (Stripe) are enabled.
faq.q7: Where do I upload images and videos for my posts?
faq.a7: Under Media (/media). Upload files there, then attach them when creating or editing a post in the calendar. Limits depend on your plan.
faq.q8: What is the to-do list for?
faq.a8: It's a personal task list (To-do in the menu): add items, mark them done or pending, and delete them. Available to all users.
faq.q9: How do I change the language or theme?
faq.a9: Under Settings → Profile for language (Spanish/English). Under Settings → Appearance for theme (light/dark/auto) and accent colour.
faq.a10: Use Settings → Support to send a message, or the email/channel indicated on the website or in the copyright notice.
faq.a11: Stream mode is a toggle in the header (video icon). When it's on, sensitive data in Settings → Bots and Settings → Profile (API key, URLs, email, Discord webhook) is hidden so you can share your screen during a stream safely. Turn it off to see and copy your keys again.
faq.q12: Where do I get chat command URLs for Nightbot or Streamer.bot?
faq.a12: Go to Settings → Bots. You'll see your API key and a table of chat commands (e.g. !nextstream, !schedule, !goal) with copy-paste URLs that include your key. Use those URLs in Nightbot, Streamer.bot, or Mix It Up. Use stream mode when sharing your screen so the key stays hidden.
